description: Standardization rollup for cards common balance data grouped by product and currency.

test_cases.name: Schema Validation
test_cases.objective: Ensure the standardized dataset exposes exactly the expected columns.

test_cases.name: Aggregation Accuracy
test_cases.objective: Verify the summed txn_amt per (product_id, txn_ccy) matches the source feed.

test_cases.name: Group Uniqueness
test_cases.objective: Confirm each (product_id, txn_ccy) pair appears only once in the standardized output.

test_cases.name: Row Count Alignment
test_cases.objective: Check the number of rows equals the distinct (product_id, txn_ccy) combinations from the source.

test_cases.name: Total Amount Conservation
test_cases.objective: Validate that the grand total of txn_amt in the output equals the grand total from the source data.

test_cases.name: Null Safety
test_cases.objective: Ensure product_id, txn_ccy, and total_txn_amt contain no null values after aggregation.
